## What happened

Describe the expected and actual result.

## Steps to reproduce

Include the build, route, role, device, browser and connection conditions where relevant. Use only synthetic accounts or redacted evidence.

## Impact and verification

Who is affected? What would demonstrate the fix? For mobile or accessibility issues, include the affected interaction and assistive technology if relevant.

For security concerns, follow [the security policy](../../SECURITY.md).
